exposure: type of VTE (DVT or pulmonary embolism)
outcome: Anxiety after VTE (measured by Patient-Reported Outcome Measurement Information System short form 8a T-scores)
cohort: Patients diagnosed with acute deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and/or pulmonary embolism were included, excluding those with cancer, pregnancy, or puerperium.
finding: While most patients with VTE reported reduced anxiety over 3 months, 23.7% experienced worsening, with female sex, older age, higher baseline anxiety, no VTE history, and DVT being associated with increased anxiety at 3-month follow-up.
